# Phase Two — Architecture Map And Twenty Improvements

## Systems To Inspect Before Rewriting
- Static response pipeline and public SEO modules.
- Generated public catalog and generator source.
- Robots/sitemap state.
- Product manifest/readiness tests.
- Shared commerce event helpers and any existing telemetry sink.
- AwtsServer initialization path and server listen boundary.
- Global UI foundation, commerce bridge, Radiance modules, and live browser state.

## Twenty Improvements
1. Keep crawlability server-side while preserving progressive enhancement.
2. Make generated catalog drift fail deterministically in tests.
3. Normalize every public route before SEO/sitemap generation.
4. Exclude noncanonical or broken routes from monetization claims.
5. Keep structured data truthful and minimal.
6. Add canonical metadata only after route existence is proven.
7. Generate sitemap XML directly from canonical route testimony, not filesystem guesses.
8. Keep robots simple and reference only existing sitemap output.
9. Avoid all JSON file output; use JS modules, XML, HTML, CSS, and Markdown only.
10. Define one privacy-safe event vocabulary before instrumenting UI.
11. Make telemetry failure non-blocking and product functionality independent.
12. Never record private content or user-provided payloads in analytics.
13. Track paid outcome success separately from purchase intent.
14. Track insufficient-credit states separately from execution failures.
15. Track return-after-purchase so checkout context loss is measurable.
16. Add readiness checks for live capability handler coverage.
17. Add readiness checks for crawlable hub inventory counts.
18. Add readiness checks for source-law violations in touched platform modules.
19. Time cold-start stages with monotonic clocks and no behavior changes.
20. Preserve concurrent dirty work by reading before each whole-file rewrite and avoiding unrelated files.
